text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain, locked in a border dispute with Qatar, is to boycott next Gulf Arab summit in Doha.
- Cabinet discusses draft law to develop Shura council. Bahrain's Emir promised in June to give the council more power and increase its members to widen representation.
- Oil and industry minister inaugurates a unit for small and medium industries, says they would provide more investment and job opportunities.
- Royal Air Maroc to discontinue Casablanca-Riyadh-Bahrain weekly flight until early next spring.
- U.N. Industrial Development Organisation has offered technical assistance to develop Bahrain garment industry.
